scope: Current 100 candidate identities; no ClearSignal answer captures or holdout tuning.

approved_policy.basis: total company equity; one issuer across classes/ADRs
approved_policy.secondary_observations: provisional after required identity checks; conflicting values must be resolved before admission

input_evidence.method: Compare the summary and October 9 historical table row from the SAME rendered page response used in refreshed_source_observations.json. Reuse original per-read UTC timestamps, preventing cross-fetch drift.

comparison_method.numeric_arithmetic: Exact base-10 integer USD conversion, no binary floating-point comparison.
comparison_method.literal_rounding_model: For displayed decimal precision, conditional interval [displayed value - half last-place unit, displayed value + half last-place unit). Source rounding method is not confirmed.
comparison_method.coarser_million_model: For nonidentical million-unit historical rows ending in zero only, test a hypothetical $0.1m rounding step. It is an explicit unconfirmed explanation, never admission or a selected conflicting value.
comparison_method.basis: Generic total-company/all-outstanding-shares definition and USD quote header are present on all 100 pages. These support provisional secondary use but do not prove issuer-specific class aggregation or ADR ratio/FX conventions.

summary.unresolved_source_conflicts_meaning: 45 unexplained numerical differences remain; only 26 block source selection after the explicitly approved 19-name rule.
